stories.title: Putin orders halt to Kyiv strikes as Witkoff and Kushner arrive in Moscow with new peace plan
stories.reason: In their first-ever visit to Ukraine, Trump's envoys are carrying a proposal to end the war, and both Moscow and Kyiv have agreed to a rare reciprocal pause on strikes on each other's capitals through Monday.

stories.title: CENTCOM destroys three Iranian oil tankers after IRGC missile attack on US warships
stories.reason: Admiral Brad Cooper's explicit '3-for-2' warning -- destroying three tankers from Iran's oil shadow fleet for every US ship targeted -- marks a new economic-pressure tactic in the six-month war.

stories.title: Ukraine's anti-corruption bureau raids Prosecutor General's Office over scam call-center ring
stories.reason: NABU detained a senior prosecutorial official accused of protecting a criminal network, a striking institutional scandal breaking just as US-brokered peace talks resume.

stories.title: Bipartisan backlash against data centers becomes a midterm campaign flashpoint
stories.reason: Campaigns have spent more than $45 million on ads mentioning data centers this year, with Democrats and Republicans both tapping into 77% of Americans' concerns about rising electricity costs from AI buildout.

stories.title: Anthropic says Claude produced the first machine-checked formalization of Fermat's Last Theorem
stories.reason: Working largely autonomously over 11 days via the open-source Prove2Me platform, Claude generated 13 million lines of Lean code proving 30,300 theorems -- a task mathematicians expected to take years.

stories.title: UN report finds 1,500-2,000 former Colombian soldiers fighting as mercenaries for Sudan's RSF
stories.reason: The UN panel traces networks in the UAE, Colombia and Chad supplying fighters, weapons and training to the paramilitary group, underscoring how international actors are fueling what aid groups call the world's worst humanitarian crisis.

stories.title: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion in MediaTek to expand AI chip and computing partnership
stories.reason: The deal extends Nvidia's NVLink Fusion platform to MediaTek's custom AI chips and PC hardware, a hedge against hyperscalers increasingly building their own silicon.

stories.title: Nvidia's stock lags peers despite doubling revenue, as investors weigh AI capex risks
stories.reason: Even with revenue more than doubling and guidance raised again, Nvidia shares have underperformed AI peers this year as markets grow more cautious about the sustainability of the industry's spending boom.
